text:
The design uses an NMOS-input preamp, then a PMOS common-source gain stage, then a CMOS inverter that drives the 50 fF load. I have not simulated it; the initial values are hand estimates for the optimiser to refine.

**Why this topology**
- **NMOS input pair:** With VCM = 0.9 V and PMOS |Vth| ≈ 1 V, a PMOS pair would need its source near 1.9 V, above VDD. NMOS is the only workable input pair. The tail node sits around 0.2 V.
- **Stage 1 (preamp):** M1 and M2 form the pair, with a PMOS current-mirror load. The diode side is on M1 (vinp), so node o1 rises when vinp > vinn.
- **Stage 2 (gain):** M5 is a PMOS common-source stage on o1, with an NMOS current-source load M6. Its gate sits at the same DC level as the mirror diode. That makes its current set by the M5/M3 width ratio, which keeps systematic offset low. When o1 rises, o2 falls.
- **Stage 3 (output):** A CMOS inverter turns o2 into a rail-to-rail vout. Rising vinp gives o1 up, o2 down, vout HIGH, which is the required polarity.
- **Bias:** IREF goes into the diode MB. The tail (M7) and the stage-2 load (M6) mirror it, sharing one channel length LB.
- **Power budget:** 38 µW allows about 21 µA total. The starting split is roughly IREF ≈ 2 µA, tail ≈ 2×IREF and stage 2 ≈ 3×IREF. That is about 12 µA if IREF is 2 µA. The optimiser can trade static current for delay.
- **Gain:** Two gain stages give an estimated DC gain of several hundred. A 10 mV overdrive needs about 90 V/V to swing the inverter input, so this has margin.

```spice
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* ---- bias: IREF from VDD into ibias ----
MB   ibias ibias vss  vss nfet W={WB} L={LB}
MT   tail  ibias vss  vss nfet W={WT} L={LB}
* ---- stage 1: NMOS diff pair, PMOS mirror load ----
M1   d1  vinp tail vss nfet W={WIN} L={LIN}
M2   o1  vinn tail vss nfet W={WIN} L={LIN}
M3   d1  d1   vdd  vdd pfet W={WP}  L={LP}
M4   o1  d1   vdd  vdd pfet W={WP}  L={LP}
* ---- stage 2: PMOS common source, NMOS current-source load ----
M5   o2  o1    vdd vdd pfet W={WCS} L={LP}
M6   o2  ibias vss vss nfet W={WL}  L={LB}
* ---- stage 3: output inverter ----
M7   vout o2 vdd vdd pfet W={WINVP} L=0.15
M8   vout o2 vss vss nfet W={WINVN} L=0.15
.ends dut
```
